card.name: Digits inside dosing table cells
card.fires_on: A single digit (0, 1, 3, 4) inside a flattened dosing or data table, in a row of bare numbers. It often starts or continues a number in the next column, such as a weight range or dose.

modes.label: Lone digit cell
modes.description: A whole-number cell, often 0 or 1, between columns of counts or doses.

modes.label: Digit starting a larger number
modes.description: The first digit of a multi-digit value in a table row, such as a weight or dose.
modes.example: Number of 50 mg capsules Number of 250 mg capsules 4 to 5 1 <<0>> 6 to 9 2

card.plain: It fires on single digits inside tables of doses, weights and counts where the numbers run together.
evidence: Number of 250 mg capsules 4 to 5 1 <<0>> 6 to 9 2
